Package com.nexuslink.protocol.s3

Class S3PresignedUrl

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.s3.S3PresignedUrl
public final class S3PresignedUrl extends Object
Pure AWS Signature Version 4 query-string presigner for Amazon S3 objects. Given credentials and an object reference, it produces a time-limited, self-authenticating HTTPS URL that a client can use to GET or PUT a single object without any further AWS credentials on the wire. No AWS SDK is used: only Mac (HmacSHA256), MessageDigest (SHA-256) and the standard library.

The presigner is side-effect-free and deterministic: the same inputs together with the same Instant always yield the same URL, which makes it fully unit-testable offline. Callers that do not care about determinism can use the overloads that default the signing time to Instant.now().

What is signed. Following the S3 query-string presigning scheme, the only signed header is host and the payload hash literal is UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD. All of the authentication material (algorithm, credential scope, date, expiry, signed-header list and — for temporary credentials — the session token) travels in X-Amz-* query parameters. The resulting X-Amz-Signature is appended last and is not itself part of the canonical query used to compute the signature.

Endpoint styles. By default the URL uses virtual-hosted-style addressing, https://<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com/<key>. Path-style addressing, https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com/<bucket>/<key>, is available via the pathStyle flag for buckets or tooling that require it.

Instances are immutable; the class is a stateless collection of static factory methods plus a S3PresignedUrl.Request parameter object for the full-control path.

    • presign

      public static String presign(S3PresignedUrl.Request req, Instant signingTime)
      Presigns a URL from a fully-specified S3PresignedUrl.Request at a caller-supplied signing time. This is the core entry point; the get/put helpers delegate here.
      Parameters:
      req - the request parameters (must be non-null and valid)
      signingTime - the instant used to derive X-Amz-Date and the credential scope date
      Returns:
      an absolute https:// URL carrying the SigV4 query-string signature
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any input is blank, the method is not GET/PUT, or the expiry is outside 1..604800
